main.description: A project on the /projects page, belonging to a dev.roe.projectCategory.

category.description: Strong-ref to the parent dev.roe.projectCategory record.

links.description: Relevant destinations for the project. The site links the card at the first `linkRoleWebsite`, falling back to the first link of any role.

images.description: Visual assets for the project. The site renders the first `purposeScreenshot`, falling back to the first image of any purpose.

status.description: Release or maintenance status. `unmaintained` and `discontinued` render the card as archived.

icon.description: UnoCSS icon class, e.g. `i-ri:rocket-line`. Used when there is no image.

order.description: Lower values render first within the category. Defaults to 100 in the editor.
